title: Agent API
one_liner: A FastAPI chat agent on one provider-agnostic LLM door that can call the sales-forecast service as a tool, with no key in source.

steps.text: The capstone agent on common/llm.py: three example questions
Forecast question: the agent calls the forecast tool on the sales service
The tool call is visible in the reply: forecast(store, days) and where the numbers came from
Which model won: answered from the saved metrics
A plain reasoning question: no tool, just the model
The badge says which provider answered; with no key it is the offline mode
